text: こいつは　とても　そだてやすいぞ！

structure.jp: とても　そだてやすいぞ！

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい stuck onto a verb stem says the action is easy to do. そだてやすい = 'easy to raise'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end makes the statement strong and confident, in a rough male way of talking. そだてやすいぞ = 'it's easy to raise, I tell you!'
